en.headline: Three arrested after Mong Kok car chase linked to alleged drug deal
en.dek: Police detained a 29-year-old disqualified driver, his girlfriend and a passenger after a private car fled officers, struck vehicles and left an officer injured on Monday; the trio face drug and traffic charges.
body: Police have arrested three people after a private car sped away from officers in Mong Kok on Monday afternoon, colliding with multiple vehicles and injuring a police officer during what investigators say was a suspected drug delivery.

Chief Inspector Chan Chi-wa of the Yau Tsim District Crime Squad said the 29-year-old driver, who was already disqualified from driving, allegedly fled after officers approached the vehicle for using a mobile phone. The car ran red lights and struck other vehicles before being abandoned in Hung Hom. The driver was later located in a Kwun Tong hotel room on Wednesday.

His 19-year-old girlfriend, a two-way permit holder, was arrested for allegedly assisting an offender by booking the room and buying replacement clothes. A 46-year-old man believed to be the intended recipient of the drugs was arrested in Mong Kok on Tuesday. Officers seized a small quantity of controlled substances, cash and the vehicle keys. The driver and girlfriend are due to appear at Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Friday.

zh.headline: 旺角私家車逃避截查連撞多車 警拘兩男一女涉販毒
zh.dek: 警方拘捕29歲停牌司機、其19歲女友及46歲男乘客，指周一旺角懷疑進行毒品交易時逃避截查，撞傷一名警員並損毀多車。
body: 警方表示，周一午后在旺角截查一架私家車時，司機涉嫌進行毒品交易並使用手機，警員上前後車輛突然逃離，連撞多車並撞傷一名機動部隊男警。
油尖警區刑事總督察陳熾華指，29歲男司機當時已停牌，其後將車輛棄於紅磡，周三在觀塘酒店房被捕；同房的19歲持雙程證女友被指協助租房及購買替換衣服，涉嫌協助罪犯。
46歲男乘客周二在旺角因涉嫌販運危險藥物被捕。警方檢獲少量受管制藥物、現金及車匙。男司機及女友周五將於九龍城裁判法院應訊。
